sections.excerpt:

and commissions and estimated offering expenses payable by us. We intend to use the net proceeds from this offering, for general
corporate purposes, which may include research, development, and manufacturing of our product candidates, working capital, capital expenditures, other corporate expenses, and acquisitions of, or strategic transactions in, complementary products,

sections.title: Dilution
sections.excerpt:
DILUTION If you invest in our common stock in this offering, your ownership interest will be diluted immediately to the extent of the difference
between the price per share of our common stock in this offering and the as adjusted net tangible book value per share of our common stock immediately after this offering. Our historical net tangible book value as of June 30, 2026 was $(9.97) million, or $(0.09) per share, based on 111,656,805 shares of
common stock outstanding as of such date. Our historical net tangible book value per share represents total tangible assets, less total liabilities, all divided by the number of shares of common stock outstanding on June 30, 2026.
